clue.text: Bases, semi-detached, for diplomats

definitions.note: a phrase meaning the buildings where diplomats work, standing for the noun

indicators.note: detached here means the words are pulled apart and their letters rebuilt in a new order

explanation.surface: Property listing: semi-detached houses available for foreign diplomats.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Semi-detached' reads as a house type, but 'semi' is fodder and 'detached' the anagram signal: BASES plus SEMI rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Ambassadors and their staff work from these official missions abroad.

clue.text: A letter from Greece the board find inconsistent

parts.note: mu is the twelfth letter of the Greek alphabet
a board is a table, as in bed and board

explanation.surface: A board of directors finds a letter from Greece contradictory.
explanation.definitionFit: Changeable, liable to alter, hence not steady.

clue.text: Stranded, so may well be on guard

indicators.note: may well be suggests the words could be rearranged into another form

explanation.surface: A stranded person would naturally be watchful.
explanation.definitionFit: A ship stuck on the shore or seabed is beached.

clue.text: Scarcity, but only for a brief period

parts.note: brief means short
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: A scarcity that is luckily only temporary.
explanation.definitionFit: A lack of something needed, a deficiency.

clue.text: The farewell of love left in the air

indicators.note: in tells us one piece sits inside another

parts.note: an air is a song
love is zero in tennis, shown as the letter O

explanation.surface: A lovers' parting words hanging in the air.
explanation.definitionFit: An informal goodbye said when parting.

clue.text: Hated being forced to split up in a dire situation

indicators.note: being forced suggests the letters are pushed into a different arrangement
in a down entry, up means the word is written from bottom to top

parts.note: to split is to part

explanation.surface: Someone forced to separate from a hated partner finds things grim.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down entry 'up' turns the synonym for 'split' bottom to top; 'being forced' signals the anagram of 'Hated'. The surface's 'split up' as a breakup is the misdirection.
explanation.definitionFit: A place or structure that is very dangerous, likely to kill.

clue.text: Most preposterous trial -everybody's taken in

indicators.note: taken in means one piece is held inside another

parts.note: a test is a trial
all means everybody, the 's being is

explanation.surface: An absurd court case in which everyone is fooled.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taken in' reads as 'deceived', which fits the surface of a preposterous trial, but it is a container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A tall story is far-fetched, so the superlative means most implausible.

clue.text: Set against a lengthy party

parts.note: lengthy means long
a side is a party in a dispute

explanation.surface: Someone opposed to a long-running party.
explanation.definitionFit: Placed beside or next to something, positioned by it.

clue.text: A cover-up in the main

explanation.definitionFit: A loose protective garment worn over clothes, and an adverb meaning on the whole or generally.

clue.text: Berates about lead weight

definitions.note: a verb in the third person, while the answer is the base form of the phrasal verb

parts.note: the lead in a film or play is its star
a ton is a unit of weight

explanation.surface: Someone scolds over the weight of a piece of lead.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' is only a link here; 'lead' looks like the metal but means the star performer.
explanation.definitionFit: To start on someone is an informal idiom for attacking them verbally.

clue.text: A winger having to arrange loan? Rot!

indicators.note: the instruction to arrange tells us to put these letters into a fresh order

explanation.surface: A dismissive reply to someone asked to organise a loan.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rot!' looks like an exclamation of disbelief but its letters join LOAN in the anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: This small European bunting is a bird, and a bird is a creature with wings.

clue.text: Military order concerning roll being taken

parts.note: concerning means about, on the subject of
to roll over is to turn

explanation.surface: A drill command given while a roll call is taken.
explanation.definitionFit: A parade-ground command telling soldiers to face the opposite direction.

clue.text: The cause of renewed ill-feeling

parts.note: read as a medical event, this is the thing that makes a patient feel unwell again after recovering

explanation.walkthrough: 'ill-feeling' looks like resentment but is literal sickness.
explanation.definitionFit: A return of illness after an apparent recovery.

clue.text: Exceptionally self, conscious people

parts.note: read with the comma, these are people conscious of the self to an exceptional degree, wholly wrapped up in themselves

explanation.walkthrough: The comma splits 'self-conscious' (shy) into people conscious of self (vain).
explanation.definitionFit: Vain, self-centred people think and talk mainly about themselves.

clue.text: An old sailor goes back without publicity

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so one piece wraps around the other
back tells us the word goes is written in reverse order

parts.note: an ad is a piece of publicity

explanation.surface: A veteran mariner returns home with no fanfare.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' is used in its old sense of outside, not 'lacking', which the surface of no publicity suggests.
explanation.definitionFit: An informal term for a seaman with long experience at sea.

clue.text: He's offered silly sum — bitter as a result

definitions.note: read as he who has offered, a person who puts something forward

indicators.note: silly suggests the letters are jumbled into a foolish new order

explanation.surface: Someone offered a ridiculous sum feels resentful as a result.
explanation.definitionFit: One who puts forward a proposal or entry for consideration.

clue.text: Management slip-up

explanation.definitionFit: Supervision of work, and a mistake made through failing to notice.

clue.text: Agitate and rave outside the home

definitions.note: a phrase describing where the thing is, standing for the noun

indicators.note: to agitate is to stir up, so these letters are shaken into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone is told to stir up trouble and shout outside a house.
explanation.definitionFit: A roofed porch or gallery running along the exterior of a house.

clue.text: Could finish with a bird, due to a personal problem

indicators.note: finish points to the final letter of the word could

parts.note: and means with, joining things together
the ruff is a wading bird

explanation.surface: A personal problem might end with a bird.
explanation.definitionFit: Flakes of dead skin from the scalp, an embarrassing condition.

clue.text: Floored by having the history told

explanation.definitionFit: Having floors or levels, and celebrated in tales and legend.

clue.text: Everyone wants a bit

parts.note: a piece is a bit of something

explanation.surface: All the people want a share.
explanation.definitionFit: Meaning each, as in 'they cost a pound each', which is a share for every one.

clue.text: The whole thing 18 green it's revolting

indicators.note: revolting means rising up, so these letters rebel into a new order

parts.note: taken as it, the 's being is

explanation.surface: Something entirely green is disgusting.
explanation.walkthrough: The '18' in this text is an OCR artefact and acts only as a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A whole number, a complete unit with no fraction.

clue.text: Business interest

explanation.definitionFit: A firm or company, and a matter one cares about.

clue.text: It's lustreless hair for the rest!

definitions.note: a phrase describing what the thing is used for, standing for the noun

parts.note: mat is a variant spelling of matt, without shine
a tress is a lock of hair

explanation.surface: An exclamation about dull hair, oddly linked to taking a rest.
explanation.definitionFit: The padded base of a bed is used for sleeping and resting.

clue.text: Changes of clothing

explanation.definitionFit: Alterations or switches, and simple straight dresses or undergarments.

clue.text: The principal's sound memorial

parts.note: a head is a school principal, with the possessive S kept
a tone is a sound

explanation.surface: A school head's sound memorial, as if a fine monument.
explanation.definitionFit: A carved slab set at a grave commemorates the dead person.

clue.text: Ends in a much better minimum pay deal

indicators.note: in tells us the letters sit inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: A wage dispute concludes with a much improved minimum pay settlement.
explanation.definitionFit: Stations at the ends of lines, the plural of terminus, so also simply end points.

clue.text: Old citizen-retiring gentle woman

indicators.note: retiring means going backwards, so the word is read in reverse

parts.note: a gentle is a maggot used as fishing bait, a grub
her stands for a woman

explanation.surface: A gentle lady from an old town retires.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gentle' looks like an adjective but is an angler's word for a maggot: GRUB reversed gives BURG.
explanation.definitionFit: A freeman of a borough or town, used of a citizen in earlier times.

clue.text: Looks over heated, as far as one can see

definitions.text: as far as one can see
definitions.note: a phrase describing a range, standing for the noun

parts.note: to eye something is to look it over
heated means hot

explanation.surface: Someone casts a hot glance over things, as far as can be seen.
explanation.definitionFit: The distance the eye can reach, the range of vision.

clue.text: Enduring pain

explanation.definitionFit: Putting up with something, and the distress or anguish felt.
